## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what the feature is and why it would be valuable.

## 🎯 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or pain point is. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 🚀 Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the user experience should work.

## 🔄 Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups or References
Add any sketches, screenshots, or API references if applicable.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, edge cases, or details about the feature request here.
